sentences.text: Heard Mr. Yogendra Pal Singh, the learned counsel for applicant and the learned A.G.A. for State.
2. Perused the record.

3. Challenge in this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is to the order dated 27.01.2023 passed by Special Judge (POCSO) Court No. 3/Additional Sessions Judge, Meerut in Sessions Trial No. 158 of 2017 (State Vs. Ashwani), under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Sections 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Daurala, District Meerut, whereby the application dated 13.12.2022 filed by accused applicant for ossification test of the prosecutrix for determining her age has been rejected.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for applicant submits that order impugned in present application is manifestly illegal and without jurisdiction.
The only evidence available regarding the age of the prosecutrix is Class Vth certificate of the prosecutrix, wherein her date of birth is recorded as 15.10.2000.

There is Ashwani vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152123356/
1 nothing on record to show that the prosecutrix had attended any other institution prior to her admission in Class Vth.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly accused/applicant filed an application dated 13.12.2022 before Court below praying therein that the ossification test of the prosecutrix be got conducted to ascertain her correct age.

Aforesaid application was rejected by Court below on the ground that previously an application dated 30.9.2022 was filed by applicant with the prayer that the Principal of the institution be summoned along with the entire record to prove the date of birth of the prosecutrix as recorded in the school records.
The said application was allowed and the Principal of the institution, where the prosecutrix had studied for the first time was summoned.
The Principal of the institution duly appeared before Court below along with the record.
Thereafter, he was examined as a Court witness.

5. It is after the statement of the Principal of institution was recorded, that the application dated 13.12.2022 has been filed by accused applicant praying therein that ossification test of the prosecutrix be got conducted to determine her real age.
In view of the aforesaid facts Court below concluded that no good ground exists to allow the application.
Accordingly, it rejected the application.
6. Learned counsel for applicant submits that justice should not only be done but should also seen to be done.
Upto this stage, there is no such cogent material on record, on the basis of which it can be concluded without doubt that the date of birth of prosecutrix is 15.10.2000.
There is no corroborative material either in respect of the date of birth of the prosecutrix.
There is nothing on record as to on what basis the date of birth of prosecutrix was recorded as 15.10.2000.
In the aforesaid circumstances, Court below ought to have allowed the application dated 13.12.2000.
It is thus urged that order impugned in present application is, therefore, liable to be quashed by this Court.
7. Per contra, the learned A.G.A. has opposed the present application.

He submits that first application of the applicant was allowed by Court below and the entire record of the institution,
where the prosecutrix had studied was summoned.

Thereafter, the Principal of the institution,
where the prosecutrix had studied for the first time was also examined as a Court witness.
On the above premise, the learned A.G.A. submits that the application dated 13.12.2022 was engineered only to delay the trial.
The same clearly speaks of the malacious conduct of the applicant.

As such,
no jurisdictional error has been committed by Court below in passing the order impugned.

8. Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State and upon perusal of record, this Court finds that the only evidence regarding the age of prosecutrix which has come on record of aforementioned Sessions Trial (POCSO case) is the class Vth certificate of the prosecutrix,
wherein her date of birth is recorded as 15.10.2000.
The Court is at loss to understand as to how the prosecutrix could have been admitted to class Vth directly without her having attended any educational institution prior to the same.
It is a well accepted facet of the principles of natural justice that justice should not only be done but also seen to be done.
The prayer made by accused applicant was to conclude the proceedings in a free and fair manner.
An accused has also the right to face trial and he cannot be denied the right to plead his defence in the light of additional material which can be considered only during the course of trial.

In case, the prayer of the applicant was Ashwani vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152123356/
2 allowed, it would only manifest the principle of fair trial.
9.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of above, this Court finds that interest of justice shall be served, in case, the ossification test of the prosecutrix is got conducted to determine her age before deciding the guilt of accused-applicant.
10.
Resultantly, present application succeeds and is allowed.

Order impugned dated 27.01.2023 passed by Special Judge (POCSO) Court No. 3/Additional Sessions Judge, Meerut, in Sessions Trial No. 158 of 2017 (State Vs. Ashwani), under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Sections 3/4 POCSO Act,
Police Station Daurala, District Meerut, is, hereby, quashed.
